reviews.title: 2 hours late both flights - avoid if you can!
reviews.text: Flew twice to and from Big Corn: and both times over 2.5 hours late delayed on each flight. No notice or communication until we arrived 2 hours before scheduled departure. Hopeless and try to avoid if you can
reviews.author: Grant D

reviews.title: Terrible Service - Overbooked
reviews.text: Return morning flight from Big Corn to Managua was overbooked and had to wait 3 hours for another plane to be sent from Managua. Treated as “first come first served” by the airline, they say the “plane is delayed” but clearly all the passengers before us got on their flight and left on time. Considering the price you pay for such a short flight it left us with a sour taste in mouth after a pleasant and relaxing time on little Corn. Staff unfriendly and unhelpful. Also on arriving (Managua to Big Corn) we were singled out and searched for no apparent reason. Apparently the dog “showed interest” in our bags but clearly the dog couldn’t have cared less. Looking for an excuse to rifle through our bags and open even single thing (souvenir bag by souvenir bag) After 40min we were extremely lucky we didn’t miss the Panga to Little Corn. Overall experience with La Costena, AWFUL, avoid them if you can!
reviews.author: jtship2018

reviews.title: A necessary flight
reviews.text: Flew Managua to Blue Fields and back. Service pretty good. A bit bazaar on the return leg not even having a boarding pass. Security does riffle through bags, and I have heard you need to keep an eye on them. We locked our bags so that security would have to ask us to unlock for them to search. We were not asked, and therefore avoided any theft. Flight is about an hour. Prop plane was old but seemed safe enough. Plane was full both ways and on time.
reviews.author: charlieg777796

reviews.title: Flexible and Helpful Staff
reviews.text: I haven't flown yet, but me and a group of people will be flying from Managua to Big Corn Island in a month and I am so impressed already by the great service from Costena Airlines. We were only able to book six members of our group before the flight we wanted sold out. I reached out to La Costena and within a couple days they helped me get an extra spot for the last person in our group.
reviews.author: Kristina J

reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN BY SECURITY LADY CHECKING BAGS IN BIG CORN
reviews.text: Count your money before and after having your hand luggage checked by the security staff when entering the gate. We had $50 stolen from a purse in our hand luggage by the lady checking bags. Very unprofessional and bloody annoying. We were flying from big corn to Managua on the morning flight.
reviews.author: Dobby

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We flew from Managua to Big Corn Island and then back a week later. On the way there we were in a 12 passenger plane and on the way back it was a 40 passenger plane. I guess they just fly whatever plane they have a need for that day. On the way out we did not stop at Bluefields, however on the way back to Managua we did. They are very efficient and we were unloaded and reloaded in no time and back in the air. They were very flexible with us on the way back to Managua which we really appreciated. We were not suppose to leave until 3:30 pm on our flight but we had to take the 6:30 am panga so we were there very early. They had room on the early flight to Managua and they let us get on that plane so we weren't stuck at the little airport all day. We planned on exploring Big Corn a little bit while we were there, but it was raining so we would have been stuck if La Costena's staff had not been super flexible and helpful and got us on the earlier flight. So thank you!! PS...Trip Advisor doesn't recognize Corn Islands or Bluefields and won't allow the review without it so hopefully they can get that changed for you so that you can receive reviews :-) (I just used my local airport in the states so I could post this...La Costena does NOT fly to Newark, NJ)
reviews.author: TheGratefulSole

reviews.title: nice and easy
reviews.text: We flew round trip to big corn island with these guys (ignore my destination trip advisor does not recognize big corn island as an airport) all good with these guys. pilots were friendly only 12 people in Cessna plane no issues at all. never felt unsafe. they put our baggages on a separate flight which kind of freaked us out but we were promised that our baggages would be waiting for us on big corn island and sure enough it was.
reviews.author: simnix

reviews.title: Nice flight, worst service, missing luggage
reviews.text: The flight was fine however it is a tiny plane and they wouldn’t take our luggage. They lied and said it would arrive 20 minutes after we did and it turns out we would not receive it until that afternoon.
reviews.author: Katie L

reviews.title: Thank You Bismark!
reviews.text: We recently flew La Costena from Managua to the Corn Islands (not Mexico City as TripAdvisor did not recognize Big Corn Island, Aug 2018) and I was really happy with the service. This was our first time to Nicaragua and we were worried about our connection and about flight changes caused by the political situation there. The manager, Bismark, was really helpful. We had one flight change caused by the airport (MGA) that changed the day of our arrival and he was able to modify our reservation without charge. Also, we were running late on our flight from Mexico City (due to Aeromexico) and I let him know what was happening and he delayed the flight out to Big Corn for a bit so we could make it. Thank you for helping make our Vacation great.
reviews.author: Jordan S

reviews.title: Never make changes once booked... it is a nightmare!
reviews.text: This company is absolutely impossible to get ahold of. We had to change our flight date, and everytime I called the phone just rang and rang. If someone answered, I was immediately transferred and the phone would just ring and ring and end up at a voicemail everytime. I finally got someone on the phone who told me I could only make changes to the itinerary via email. I sent the email, and never heard back. I finally convinced someone to stay on the phone with me and change the flight because we were just 5 hours away from our original flight departure time! Once we made the changes (after 2 weeks of trying via phone, email, voicemail) I never got a new itinerary and had no idea if our new flights were actually booked. I tried calling again to get an itinerary emailed to me, but still have not gotten through to anyone after trying for 3 days.
reviews.author: Tess M

reviews.title: WATCH OUT FOR BAGGAGE STAFF THIEVES
reviews.text: Be very careful when flying from big corn airport to Managua with la costena. I had 15,000 cordobas (c400 dollars) stolen by baggage handling staff and the airline did nothing about it. I had money hidden in my checked baggage and was called into a side room under the pretence of extra checks, however they saw the cash in the scanner somehow and then checked only the exact pocket it was in then put the bag back in the queue. (Big red flag but I naively though it was standard procedure). When we landed i saw the bag had been tampered with and the cash was missing.I told the staff at Managua immediately and they started an 'investigation' and asked us not to tell the police yet. They said to each other in Spanish 'oh not again' so it must be common. They also gave me a fake email address to speak to management as there was no one available that day. Eventually a police/staff investigation returned no result and we filed a police report. By this point all la costena staff had gone home and had not told us any more about what happened with the investigation. Be vigilant and make sure all valuables are in your hand luggage.
reviews.author: Dave S

reviews.title: Better than anticipated
reviews.text: We flew from Managua to Big Corn Island and would not have any reservations about doing it again. A few helpful hints: (1) Once you clear immigration/ baggage claim in Managua, go outside and all the way down to the left to find La Costena. (2) Once you check in and get your boarding pass in Managua, go ahead and go through their security. There is actually a large waiting area and bar once you pass through that is not visible from the check in area. (3) If you have a long layover in Managua, the airport has a nice VIP lounge that you can pay to hang out in, it is expensive (somewhere around $35) but would make a long layover more comfortable. (4) There are no assigned seats on the plane. (5) There is quite a long wait to reclaim your bag upon landing as all bags are sniffed by dogs.
reviews.author: cmsjbc2013

reviews.title: Tiny plane. - worked well
reviews.text: This was fun. Destination was SAN Carlos and then Ometepe Island just across the lake (Nicaragua) though Trip Adviser doesn’t recognise either airport. Plane was a minuscule single engined 12 seater. They solemnly weighed our baggage and charged 12 dollars for 7 pounds overweight. The pilot was at least 100 pounds overweight! Short flights with great views over Lake Nicaragua. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Oliverjulian
